siliconshaders.smartLeaves.help: Like OptiFine: leaves stay cut out, but faces between two leaf blocks are left out when chunks are built. Fewer faces and far less overdraw on Apple GPUs. All Leaves: fastest. Same Kind: borders between different trees stay. Only with cutout leaves.
siliconshaders.shaders.title: Metal Shaders
siliconshaders.shaders.scope: Experimental post-processing in the Overworld. Pack lighting, shadows and water are not supported yet.
siliconshaders.shaders.scope.short: Prototype: no pack lighting or shadows yet
siliconshaders.shaders.reload.help: Recompile the selected final pass and refresh its cache.
siliconshaders.shaders.test.description: Warm color effect to check Metal rendering
siliconshaders.shaders.status.off: Select a pack, then turn shaders on
siliconshaders.shaders.status.ready: Ready. Enter an Overworld to preview
siliconshaders.shaders.status.active: Active on Metal · Final image pass only
siliconshaders.shaders.status.overworld_: Ready. This preview supports the Overworld
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.title: Native Metal Shader
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.quality.help: Near shadow resolution. Each additional shadow level halves the resolution; transitions are smooth.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.compare: Close this menu and use F3 to compare FPS.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.smooth.help: Reduces shadow flicker. Turn off to compare motion and performance.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.distance.help: 32 to 256 blocks. Near detail stays fixed; longer distances use more GPU time.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.levels.help: 2, 3 or 4 levels. Near detail stays the same; more levels distribute quality more gradually over distance and add rendering passes.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.culling.help: Skips objects whose shadows cannot reach the visible view. Turn off to compare FPS.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.filterOptimiz: On: new filter optimization. Off: previous filter. Applies immediately; shadow culling and quality levels stay the same. Wait briefly after switching before comparing FPS.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.casterSelecti: Shares shadow-caster selection across GPU lanes. Off uses the previous selection. Shadow quality and filter optimization stay the same.
Still scans every pixel. Shares receiver-grid writes and skips updates already covered. Off uses the previous scan. The other optimization switches stay independent.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.memoryOptimiz: Avoids color and depth copies when the render target supports it. Shadow quality and smoothing stay the same. Off uses the previous copies.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.shadowMapOpti: Draws solid shadow casters without a fragment shader so the GPU can reject hidden pixels early. Only cutout blocks such as leaves keep the previous path. Shadow quality stays the same. Off draws everything together as before.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.geometryOptim: Sends each shadow quad to the GPU as 4 corners instead of 6. The triangles stay the same and shadow quality does not change. Off uses the previous output.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.farShadowCach: Redraws the far shadow map terrain only when something could change: blocks, the sun by more than half a texel, movement or settings, at least every 2 seconds. Mobs and players are drawn every frame. Off redraws the far map every frame.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.gbuffer.help: Lights terrain with the native lighting model: sun by time of day, sky light, warm block light and a tone curve. Terrain stores texture color, light and material values for it. Off uses vanilla lighting.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.gbufferView.h: Shows the G-buffer for checking. "Vanilla light (comparison)" shows the old lighting from the same data.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.exposure: Light brightness before the tone curve. 1.00 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.saturati: Color strength after the tone curve. 1.00 is neutral, 0 is black and white.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.contrast: Distance between bright and dark areas, around middle grey. 1.00 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.temperat: White balance: positive warmer (orange), negative cooler (blue). 0 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.tint.hel: Green against magenta: positive magenta, negative green. 0 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.vibrance: Boosts muted colors more than already strong ones, keeping skin and sky natural. 0 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.curve.he: How bright areas roll off to white. Standard is the previous curve; the others are matched to the same middle brightness.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.whitePoi: The scene brightness that becomes exactly white. Lower: highlights reach white sooner and the image looks brighter. 7.25 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.autoExpo: Adjusts exposure like an eye: caves and nights get brighter, very bright scenes darker. 0 is off and costs nothing.
How quickly auto exposure adapts to a new brightness, per second.
How far auto exposure brightens or darkens at most, in stops.
Raises or lowers the darkest areas; highlights stay. 0 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.midtones: Brightens or darkens the midtones; black and white stay. 1.00 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.look.highligh: Strengthens or softens the bright areas. 1.00 is neutral.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.title: Light, shadows and sky
A cloud layer closes ahead of the rain and dims the sun and moon without switching them off. The sky turns grey, brighter overhead than at the horizon, and haze thickens. Thunder darkens further, lightning flashes briefly. Off: rain looks like clear weather.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherS: How much sunlight gets through a full cloud layer. Shadows stay faintly visible accordingly. Also sets how visible the sun itself stays.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherM: How much moonlight gets through a full cloud layer. Also sets how visible the moon itself stays.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherT: Extra factor for sun, sky and ambient light in a full thunderstorm. Lower = darker.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherF: How much denser haze gets in full rain (1 = twice as dense), a little more in a storm. It stays low. Costs nothing extra.
How strongly lightning briefly brightens sky and surroundings. 0 = no flash.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherD: Thin, silvery, see-through drops instead of vanilla's strong blue streaks. Snow stays unchanged. Costs practically nothing.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.dropOpac: How strongly the drops cover in normal rain.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.dropBrig: Brightness of the silvery drops in normal rain. Light (day, night, torches) acts on top.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.stormDro: Drop opacity in a full thunderstorm; blended by thunder strength in between.
Drop brightness in a full thunderstorm.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainSpla: Vanilla's small water drops where rain hits the ground. Off saves particles. Smoke on lava and magma stays.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.weatherW: How strongly water takes the overcast sky's grey-blue and darkens in rain and thunderstorms. 0 = as in clear weather, 1 = default, 2 = twice as strong.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.wetSurfa: In rain, surfaces under the open sky get wet, glossy, reflect the sky and form puddles with rain ripples. Wets slowly and dries afterwards. Free without rain.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.wetStren: How strong the gloss, reflection and darkening of wet surfaces are.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.wetDryin: Half life of the world drying after rain. Longer = puddles and rainbows last longer (Iris default: 10 s).
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.wetPuddl: How much of the ground forms puddles. 0 = only a wet film, 1 = puddles almost everywhere.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.aurora.h: Green and violet auroras on clear nights. Computed at half resolution on sky pixels only.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraBl: Off: smooth curtains. On: a blocky, Minecraft-like pattern.
Blurs the auroras: wider, gentler curtains and softer rays. No extra sampling, so it costs next to nothing.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraDe: How far the curtains reach up the sky: higher = longer rays toward the zenith. No extra cost.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightNeb: A colorful nebula in the night sky. 0 = off.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endBlack: The black hole with its accretion disc is the End's light source. Off: no directional light and no shadows in the End, only even ambient light. This saves the shadow pass.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endPlane: A giant ringed planet in the End sky, independent of the black hole. It casts no light on the world. Costs a little performance while in view.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endRingT: Transparency of the planet's rings. 0%: full opacity of the ring pattern, 100%: invisible rings. The planet stays visible. Requires the ringed planet to be enabled.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFog.h: A cloudy fog at the height of the End's islands: violet, glowing far away, warm toward the black hole. Bodies and stars show through it, near surfaces stay clear. Independent of the black hole and the ringed planet.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogSt: Density of the End fog. 0%: no fog. Higher values make the clouds denser and brighter.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogBr: How brightly the End fog glows. Unlike fog strength, this does not change how much it hides.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogHe: The world Y coordinate the End fog lies around. The main island sits at about 60–70.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogTh: How far the fog layer reaches up and down.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogSi: How large the clouds in the End fog are.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogWi: The share of fine wisps in the clouds. 0%: only large, soft clouds, which also saves a little time.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogSp: How fast the End fog drifts. 0%: it stands still.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogEm: How strongly dense clouds glow far away. 0%: no glow.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogHo: How strongly the black hole lights the fog with warmth. Only with the black hole on.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endLight: How high the black hole stands above the horizon. It also sets the direction and length of all shadows in the End: low means long shadows.
How strongly the black hole lights the world. 0%: no directional light and no shadows.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endHoleS: How large the black hole and its disc appear in the sky.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endDiscB: Brightness of the glowing disc and its glare. Does not change the light on the world.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endStars: Brightness of the stars in the End sky. 0%: no stars.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightSta: The End sky's stars on clear nights. Rain and thunder hide them. 0 %: vanilla's stars instead.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyFeatu: Brightness of vanilla's stars. Only has an effect while "Stars at night" is at 0 %.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.endFogDi: Distance over which the End fog builds up. Smaller values bring it closer, larger ones keep the surroundings clear for longer.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainbows: Opposite the sun when it is not too high. After rain: while the world is still wet (see drying time).
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainbowS: How wide the rainbow's band of colors is.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.coloredL: Light sources tint their surroundings in their own colour (torches orange, soul fire blue, redstone red …); stained glass tints light passing through. Brightness stays vanilla.
How many chunks (and height sections) around you get colored light; further out it fades softly into plain block light. Smaller: less memory and shorter recalculation while loading and moving.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunNoonR: Red share of the noon sun color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunNoonG: Green share of the noon sun color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunNoonB: Blue share of the noon sun color.
Brightness of the sunlight on the world when the sun is high.
Red share of the sunrise/sunset sun color.
Green share of the sunrise/sunset sun color.
Blue share of the sunrise/sunset sun color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunSet.h: Brightness of the sunlight on the world when the sun is low.
Red share of the sky light day color.
Green share of the sky light day color.
Blue share of the sky light day color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyDay.h: Brightness of the sky light day.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyDuskR: Red share of the sky light dusk color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyDuskG: Green share of the sky light dusk color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyDuskB: Blue share of the sky light dusk color.
Brightness of the sky light dusk.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyNight: Red share of the sky light night color.
Green share of the sky light night color.
Blue share of the sky light night color.
Brightness of the sky light night.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.blockR.h: Red share of the block light color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.blockG.h: Green share of the block light color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.blockB.h: Blue share of the block light color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyUpR.h: Red share of the sky zenith (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyUpG.h: Green share of the sky zenith (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyUpB.h: Blue share of the sky zenith (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.horizonR: Red share of the horizon (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.horizonG: Green share of the horizon (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.horizonB: Blue share of the horizon (day) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightUpR: Red share of the sky zenith (night) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightUpG: Green share of the sky zenith (night) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightUpB: Blue share of the sky zenith (night) color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.nightHor: Red share of the horizon (night) color.
Green share of the horizon (night) color.
Blue share of the horizon (night) color.
Red share of the sunset glow color.
Green share of the sunset glow color.
Blue share of the sunset glow color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunset.h: Brightness of the colour band in the sky at sunrise and sunset. Its colour also tints the sun's sky glow when the sun is low.
Light in total darkness so caves are not black.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.blockDay: How much torch light is reduced outdoors in daylight.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.shadowFi: Sky light inside sun shadows. Below 1 darker, above 1 brighter.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.moonFull: Night light on full-moon nights (phase 0, partly 1 and 7): direct moonlight, skylight and night sky. Above 1 only skylight and night sky get brighter.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.moonPart: Night light on waxing and waning nights (phases 2 and 6, partly 1, 3, 5 and 7): direct moonlight, skylight and night sky.
Night light on new-moon nights (phase 4, partly 3 and 5): direct moonlight, skylight and night sky.
How strongly rain darkens and desaturates the sky light. Direct sunlight is set under “Sun in rain”.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.sunGlare: Wide glow in the sky around the sun, in the colours of noon sun and sunset. Also works with Minecraft's sun.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.moonGlar: Wide, cool glow in the sky around the moon. Also works with Minecraft's moon.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyFeatu: How much of the vanilla sky's sun, moon and stars stays. With a custom sun and moon this only affects the stars.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.fogHeigh: How quickly the haze thins with height.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.fogStren: 1 = fog and haze in sky color, 0 = vanilla fog color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.skyEnabl: Own sky, sun glow and fog in atmosphere color. Underwater and in lava vanilla stays.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.moonLigh: Brightness of direct moonlight, also scaled by the moon phase.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.moonShad: At night the moon lights the world and casts shadows. Off: no direct moonlight, so its colour and strength do nothing. Costs as much at night as sun shadows by day.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.handLigh: Light-emitting items in your hands (torch, lantern, glowstone, lava bucket …) light the surroundings. No shadows.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.handInte: Brightness of the hand light relative to block light.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.handRang: How far the hand light reaches. 1 is the default.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.handColo: Soul torches cyan, redstone torches red, sea lanterns and end rods cold white. Off: everything in block light color.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterAmp: Strength of wave normals. 0 = flat surface; 1 = default.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterSiz: Wave size. Higher values produce larger waves.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterDen: Color absorption and underwater fog. 0 = clear water without fog.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterVis: Visibility in blocks. Nearby surfaces remain clearer than distant ones.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterCau: Strength of animated light patterns on the floor. 0 = off.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterDis: Lens distortion on entry, exit and underwater. 0 = off.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterHig: Strength of highlights on the water surface. 0 = off.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterFas: Refraction without a matrix per search step. Same image, less GPU time. Off = previous path for comparison.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterEdg: How far before the screen edge reflections fade out (share of the screen). Anything outside the screen cannot be reflected; without a fade the reflection is cut off at the edge. 0 = no fade.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterSte: How many steps the reflection searches the screen per pixel. Fewer = faster, but thin or distant objects are missed in the reflection sooner. Default 32.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.waterRef: How thoroughly the reflection searches the image. High searches most thoroughly, medium with half the steps, low with a quarter. Faster, but thin or distant objects go missing from the reflection sooner.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.underwat: Computes underwater fog and caustics at half resolution. Saves a lot of time; the caustics get slightly softer. Off: full resolution as before.
High = previous behavior. Medium: floor light patterns from one layer instead of two. Low: no light patterns and no wave lens; fog, color and visibility remain.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.shadowHa: Evaluates shadow visibility for one pixel per 2×2 block and spreads it by surface. Saves GPU time; shadow edges get slightly softer and very fine detail may shimmer a little. Applies with smooth shadow motion.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.renderSc: The world renders with fewer pixels and Apple's MetalFX scales it up to the window size; hand and HUD stay sharp. Saves a lot of GPU time on Retina and 4K screens; at 1080p the softness shows more. 100 % = off.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.shadowFl: Compares each shadow-map value with the actual surface plane instead of one shared value. Prevents flickering self-shadows under a low sun, especially in the distance. Costs some GPU time. Off = previous behavior.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.shadowCo: Caps the shadow test's offset at 0.02 blocks and removes the shadow maps' slope-scaled depth bias. Prevents light under one-block roofs and along walls. Off = previous behavior.
siliconshaders.bench.start.help: Leaves the world, loads the fixed benchmark world and measures the same scenes with fixed options (1280×800 window, render distance 12, VSync off). Your settings are put back afterwards. Esc aborts. Results: the SiliconShaders-benchmarks folder.
siliconshaders.bench.result.title: Benchmark results
siliconshaders.camera.title: Camera effects
siliconshaders.camera.description: Adjust each effect. Hands and HUD stay sharp.
siliconshaders.camera.enabled.help: Master switch. Off skips every additional camera pass.
siliconshaders.camera.bloom.help: Adds a soft glow around bright parts of the image.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomThreshold.hel: Only brighter areas contribute, measured in linear light.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomKnee.help: Softens the transition around the threshold.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomRadius.help: Filter spacing and width of the glow.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomLevels.help: More levels broaden the glow and add small render passes.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomScale.help: 0.50 uses half, 0.25 a quarter of the image width and height.
siliconshaders.camera.dof.help: Blurs near and far surfaces outside the focus region.
siliconshaders.camera.autoFocus.help: Finds the center focus distance on the GPU.
siliconshaders.camera.focusDistance.help: Manual focus distance; also the autofocus target when aiming at the sky.
siliconshaders.camera.focusRange.help: Width of the sharp region around the focus distance.
siliconshaders.camera.dofRadius.help: Blur at infinity for a focus at 8 blocks and a 70° field of view, in pixels at 1080 lines. A close focus blurs the background more, zoom blurs everything more; the foreground up to three times.
siliconshaders.camera.dofNear.help: Blur for surfaces in front of the focus region.
siliconshaders.camera.dofFar.help: Blur for surfaces behind the focus region.
siliconshaders.camera.dofSamples.help: Quality: four times as many samples at half resolution. More smooths the blur and costs GPU time.
siliconshaders.camera.focusSpeed.help: How quickly autofocus adjusts to a new distance.
siliconshaders.camera.motion.help: Camera motion reconstructed from world depth and the previous camera. No per-object motion vectors.
siliconshaders.camera.motionStrength.hel: Scales the blur reconstructed from camera motion.
siliconshaders.camera.shutterMs.help: Desired exposure time; camera cuts and pause do not smear.
siliconshaders.camera.motionMax.help: Limits blur length during fast turns.
siliconshaders.camera.motionSamples.help: More samples smooth the motion trail.
siliconshaders.camera.flare.help: Lens ghosts from the sun and optionally moon. World depth occludes the light source.
siliconshaders.camera.flareGhosts.help: Number of ghosts along the axis toward the image center.
siliconshaders.camera.flareSpacing.help: Distribution of ghosts along their axis.
siliconshaders.camera.flareStreak.help: Strength of the horizontal light streak.
siliconshaders.camera.flareSpeed.help: Smooth transition when the light source becomes occluded.
siliconshaders.camera.flareMoon.help: Also adds fainter ghosts for the visible moon.
siliconshaders.camera.chroma.help: Offsets color channels toward the image edges.
siliconshaders.camera.chromaStrength.hel: Maximum color-channel displacement in the image corners, in pixels at 1080 lines (Retina: twice as many).
siliconshaders.camera.chromaStart.help: Color channels remain aligned inside this image radius.
siliconshaders.camera.chromaFalloff.help: How strongly the effect increases near the edges.
siliconshaders.camera.vignette.help: Tints the image edges; excludes hands and HUD.
siliconshaders.camera.vignetteRadius.hel: Start of the vignette, measured from the center.
siliconshaders.camera.vignetteSoftness.h: Width of the soft edge transition.
Blends between a rectangular and round shape.
siliconshaders.camera.vignetteR.help: Red component of the edge color.
siliconshaders.camera.vignetteG.help: Green component of the edge color.
siliconshaders.camera.vignetteB.help: Blue component of the edge color.
siliconshaders.camera.sharpen.help: Emphasizes local detail with a clamp against bright halos.
siliconshaders.camera.sharpenRadius.help: Distance to the neighboring filter samples.
siliconshaders.camera.sharpenClamp.help: Maximum change per channel in linear light.
siliconshaders.camera.filmGrain.help: Adds fine, moving film grain to the image, strongest in midtones; excludes hands and HUD. Hardly costs any GPU time.
siliconshaders.camera.grainSize.help: Size of a grain in pixels at 1080 lines; stays the same on Retina screens and at lower render resolutions.
siliconshaders.camera.godrays.help: Volumetric shafts using the existing sun/moon shadow maps. Requires active shadows. Off by default.
siliconshaders.camera.raysStrength.help: Light shaft brightness. Zero skips the effect entirely.
siliconshaders.camera.raysDensity.help: How strongly the air scatters light. Low values stay subtle; density increases underwater.
siliconshaders.camera.raysDistance.help: Maximum shaft distance along the view. Limited by geometry and existing shadow coverage.
siliconshaders.camera.raysSamples.help: More samples make shafts smoother and cost more GPU time. Starts at 16.
siliconshaders.camera.raysScale.help: 25% per image axis is cheaper; 50% preserves finer detail. Upsampling respects depth edges.
siliconshaders.camera.raysAnisotropy.hel: Higher values concentrate scattering toward the sun or moon.
siliconshaders.camera.raysMoon.help: Additional strength factor at night. Zero disables moon shafts; the existing moon phase still applies.
siliconshaders.camera.raysUnderwater.hel: Shaft strength underwater. Zero disables underwater shafts.
siliconshaders.camera.raysVariant.help: Switch between the original and optimized Godrays. All other controls apply to both.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.ssao.hel: Soft contact shading between visible surfaces, before water and glass. Hands and menus stay unchanged.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.ssaoStre: Strength of the additional contact shading.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.ssaoRadi: Fixed world-space radius. Larger values create broader shading.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.ssaoQual: High: 24, Medium: 12, Low: 8 samples at half resolution. Medium is the default for Apple silicon.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.material: Materials: %s
Toggle gloss, emission and plant transmission together. Applies to near terrain with the new lighting.
Gloss strength: %s
Strength of sun and moon highlights. Individual material differences are preserved.
Roughness: %s
Lower values make sharper highlights; higher values make surfaces more matte. 1.00 is the base tuning.
Emission: %s
Brightness of emissive texture details. Changes the glow of the surface.
Plant transmission: %s
Brightens leaves and plants when sunlight shines through them toward the camera.
Metals: %s
Material appearance for metal surfaces and matching ore inclusions.
Stone and ground: %s
Material appearance for stone, polished stone, soil, sand and snow.
Wood: %s
Material appearance for wood, bark and matching work blocks.
Plants: %s
Material appearance and transmission for leaves and plants.
Glass, ice and crystals: %s
Toggle glass, ice, crystals, slime and honey together.
Other materials: %s
Material appearance for fabrics and other special materials.
Glowing ores: %s
Additional emission from colored ore inclusions. Off by default; active redstone ore also glows without this option.
Glass & ice: also on see-through blocks: %s
Material effects for glass, ice, slime and honey. Requires classic transparency.
Material opacity: %s
Opacity of transparent materials. Angle-dependent reflections have a separate control.
Sky reflection: %s
Sky reflection strength on transparent materials. Does not reflect scene geometry.
siliconshaders.camera.bloomVariant.help: Original or HDR bloom before tone mapping. Requires New lighting. Keep other settings identical and warm up both variants before comparing FPS.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.material: Texture-dependent gloss: %s
Bright and dark texels have distinct metal, gem or polished-stone responses. Off restores the previous material profiles.
Texture detail strength: %s
Contrast of gloss and roughness within a block texture. 0 matches the previous profile.
Opaque sky reflections: %s
Smooth metals, gems and polished stone reflect the native sky. Does not reflect buildings or other blocks. Suppressed in caves.
Opaque reflection strength: %s
Sky reflection strength, weighted by view angle, roughness, material and sky light.
World reflections: %s
Smooth opaque surfaces reflect visible blocks and objects. Requires classic transparency and New lighting. Unseen regions keep the sky background.
World reflection strength: %s
Reflection strength for visible blocks and objects. 0 skips reflection passes.
World reflection quality: %s
How thoroughly world reflections search. High searches most thoroughly, medium with half the steps, low with a quarter. Render resolution is set separately.
World reflection range: %s
Maximum camera depth for tracing, in blocks. Lower values bound the search.
World reflection steps: %s
Search budget, like water reflections: 8–48. Quality scales this budget. Fewer steps are faster but can miss thin objects.
World reflection resolution: %s
100/50/25% per axis, independent of trace steps. 50% is the economical M-chip default. View bobbing follows the current draw projection.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainWind: Off gives vertical rain. Drop shape and size variation remain separately adjustable.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainAngl: Tilt away from vertical. 0° falls straight down. Gusts gently vary the tilt.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainDire: Direction the wind blows toward: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainGust: Smooth changes in wind strength and direction. 0 = steady wind.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.rainWind: Speed of wind changes. 0 holds the wind constant over time.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.dropWidt: Width of visible raindrops. 1 = original width.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.dropLeng: Length of visible raindrops. 1 = original length.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.dropVari: Varies width and length between rain columns. Stable as you move. 0 = uniform.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraDi: Rotates the curtains above the viewer. They can appear in every sky direction and directly overhead.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraEl: Moves the layer projection up or down without clipping ray height. 25° = original projection.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraSp: Speed of drifting curtains and fine rays. 1 = reference speed, 0 = freeze.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraQu: High: 25 layers. Medium: 16. Low: 10. Fewer layers reduce GPU work but can show coarser transitions.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.wetRefle: 3D distance from the camera, including height. Puddles reflect the world inside this radius; sky reflections remain outside. 0 = sky only. Soft transition at the edge.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraCu: Bends the curtains toward the horizon over a virtual round world with a soft horizon fade. Off restores the previous flat projection.
Strength of the virtual planet curvature. Higher values bend distant curtains more strongly toward the horizon. 0 is equivalent to curvature off.
Curvature applies below this elevation above the horizon. 45° reaches halfway to the zenith, 90° covers the upper sky. The transition is smooth.
siliconshaders.shaders.sun.tune.auroraCo: How many separate auroras are in the sky, from 1 to 10. Higher steps add more without shrinking the existing ones.

Visible angular radius of the sun in degrees. Does not change shadow softness.

Brightness of the visible sun disc. From about 9 it is already white without HDR bloom; higher values then only matter with HDR bloom. 0 hides the sun. The light on the world is set under Sun & moon light.
Narrow fringe right around the sun, in the sun's colour. Independent of the sun's brightness. 0 turns it off.

Brightness of the visible moon disc, also for lens flares and moon rays. 0 hides the moon. The light on the world is set under Sun & moon light.
Narrow fringe right around the moon, in the moon's colour. Follows the moon phase, independent of the moon's brightness.
Uses the world’s moon phase. Off always shows a full moon without changing world time.

Rotates the moon’s light-dark boundary. 0° is sideways; 90° is from above or below. Does not change world time.
Offsets the displayed phase from the world’s moon cycle. 45° is one phase; 180° swaps full and new moon. World lighting is unchanged.
Width of the soft transition between the lit moon and sky. 0% gives a crisp antialiased edge; higher values blend the shadowed side more gradually into the background.
